name: Davis & Elkins College
academic_ranking: Private, nonprofit liberal arts college founded in 1904 (Presbyterian Church USA affiliation). U.S. News: #15 Regional Colleges South and #18 Top Performers on Social Mobility. Enrollment roughly 680-805 students with a 12:1 student/faculty ratio; offers ~45 degree programs and an honors program.
financial_aid: Davis & Elkins is a private liberal arts college and typically offers merit-based academic scholarships and need-based financial aid; athletic aid is available for softball as an NCAA D2 program. Specific published tuition/aid figures could not be confirmed from a live source at research time (college site unreachable 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Softball competes as the Davis & Elkins Senators. Specific softball facility details were not confirmed from a live source at research time.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Mountain East Conference as the Davis & Elkins Senators (team social handle @SenatorsSB).
